Priya Kapoor: Hi team, I accepted the invite but can't open https://github.com/redwood/bootcamp-training (404). I also tried cloning and got a permission error. Is there a specific person I should ping?
Sam Liu: Welcome Priya! Two quick checks: 1) Did you finish the org SSO flow? 2) Do you have your SSH key added to your GH account?
Priya Kapoor: I clicked the authorize popup when I accepted the invite. How do I confirm SSO is active?
DevOps Bot: Hello Priya — to confirm SSO status visit https://github.com/orgs/redwood/sso or run `gh auth status`. If SSO is incomplete reply `ssolog` and an admin will check.
Priya Kapoor: `gh auth status` says: "You are logged into github.com as priya-k (OAuth)." Not obvious about SSO.
Liam O'Connor: That can be misleading. If the org requires SSO you also need to authorize the org app. Try the org SSO link and look for a button that says "Authorize redwood".
Priya Kapoor: Clicked the SSO authorize button. The org page still 404s. Cloning via SSH: `git clone git@github.com:redwood/bootcamp-training.git` shows "Permission denied (publickey)."
Ellen Park: SSH failure + 404 usually means either the GH account isn't in the correct team or the SSH key isn't on the exact GitHub account that was invited (common if you have multiple GH accounts). What does `ssh -T git@github.com` return?
Priya Kapoor: Returns: "Hi priya-k! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access." So SSH key is on my account.
Sam Liu: Okay good. I'm checking the org admin console. Priya appears as a member but NOT in the `platform-engineers` team which has access to the bootcamp repo. Assigning team now.
Sam Liu: Assigned Priya to `platform-engineers` team and gave Write access. Priya, refresh the repo URL.
Priya Kapoor: Repo visible now, thank you! Quick follow-up: tried `git push` to my feature branch and got: "remote: error: GH001: Protected branch update rejected. You must create a pull request." Is that expected?
Liam O'Connor: Yes, `main` is protected. For bootcamp we require PRs with at least one reviewer. Push to a personal branch is fine and then open a PR.
Priya Kapoor: Got it, created a branch and opened a PR. One more thing — my email on commits shows as my personal email. Is that a problem?
Ellen Park: We prefer work email for commit history and CLA checks. Add your work email to your local git config: `git config --global user.email "priya@redwood.com"` and amend the commit if needed: `git commit --amend --reset-author` then force-push to your branch.
Priya Kapoor: Fixed the email and force-pushed. PR shows green. Thanks everyone!
Sam Liu: Nice. We'll add a blurb to the onboarding doc about checking team assignment after SSO; it's an easy miss.
Priya Kapoor: Appreciate it — super smooth onboarding channel. :grinning:
